item.caption:
Saturday Blessings 

October has been FULL of wonderful trips! From Greece 🇬🇷 to Turkey 🇹🇷, North Carolina, Florida, and Nassau 🇧🇸… Gosh, I have been ON THE MOVE! 😂✈️

But out of all the places I've traveled this month, the trip that mattered most was the one I took this morning. My trip to vote. 🗳️

Because as much as I cherish the memories I've made, the pictures I've taken, and the places I've been blessed to experience, there's something about this trip that hits differently.

Those vacations gave me memories to last a lifetime. But the right to vote? The impact of that can extend far beyond my lifetime. It can affect my children's future, my grand's future, and generations I'll never get the chance to meet.

And THAT is what makes this trip so meaningful.

So, as I close out October with a month full of adventures, beautiful destinations, and unforgettable experiences, I'm reminded that not every important journey requires a passport, a plane ticket, or a suitcase.

Sometimes, the most impactful journey begins with showing up, using your voice, and exercising a right that generations before us fought hard to secure.

Traveling the world is a blessing. Having a voice in shaping its future is a responsibility. ❤️🗳️

#DeservingAdventuresAndTours #ivoted #traveladvisorwhovotes

Vote Stephanie Itkin-Goodman for Clark County Public Administrator on #ElectionDay, Tuesday, November 3.

item.caption:
Make a plan. Vote. Know where to find help. If you haven't voted yet, check your polling location and hours, make time for Tuesday and know where to turn if you have a problem.

Two days before Election Day, @sreenet and I are dedicating Ep. 415 of The Sunday #NYTReadalong to a preview of the 2026 midterm elections. What's at stake? What issues are driving voters? What are the polls telling us?

We'd also like to hear from you. What are local news outlets reporting? What campaign ads are you seeing? Which races and issues are getting attention in your community?

📅 Sunday, Nov. 1
⏰ 8:30 a.m. ET

⏰ TIME CHANGE: U.S. clocks turn back one hour overnight. We're still live at 8:30 a.m. Eastern time.

Watch live here on Instagram by tapping my profile picture when we're live. 

For gift links, PDFs, other ways to watch and the replay, check the link in bio (@neilparekh).

Voting resources: Vote.org has polling-place and voter ID information. The nonpartisan Election Protection coalition can help with questions or problems at the polls: 866-OUR-VOTE (866-687-8683). Links are on our episode page.

We'll also share gift links to Times obituaries of Dolores Huerta and Patrick Stewart, along with three #NYT175 articles.

The Sunday NYTReadalong is produced by @digimentors in partnership with @scroll_in and @scroll.global. Thank you to @MuckRack (@gregory) and @graphichisco (@WalterDGreason, @DieselFunk and @Chungspruke) for supporting the show.
